Definition

Polynomial not stored: no closed form is stored for this surface; it is defined by its shipped implementation. The shipped implementation in math_art/surfaces/algebraic.py is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface. Humbert's 1896 sextic, tied to abelian functions of genus 3 and built from a Kummer quartic: it inherits the Kummer surface's 16 nodes and adds a triple point at (1:1:1:1).
